method: Each of four linked sections on MX250 and MX450 in solo Sport practice, on fresh live deformable terrain. Manual eligibility begins 12 m before the first face with autoPlayer=false and aiControlled(0). After initial placement/speed/gear, only public ground/air controls are scripted continuously through all targets, connectors and the exit. Actual production Float32 snapshots feed the HUD landing assessment, MotocrossLandingChallenge and MotocrossFlowPractice. No mid-run resets, AI eligibility bypass, speed search or physical tuning. Scripted feasibility does not establish human ease, a full lap from the gate or visual quality.
